description: This PHP source file defines the Analytics controller class for the OpenCart admin extension system. It manages the listing, installation, and uninstallation of analytics extensions within the admin panel, handling extension detection, permissions, and dynamic controller registration.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: Controller class for managing analytics extensions within OpenCart admin panel, supporting listing, installation, and removal of extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of analytics extensions by invoking getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves available analytics extensions, checks installed extensions, handles dynamic loading of extensions, and renders the extensions list view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installing an analytics extension, including permission checks, registering controllers/models, and calling the extension's install method.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstalling an analytics extension with permission verification and cleanup.
